body: All four pull requests merged. Branch cleanup complete in both repositories, delegated and reported with per-command exit codes.U+000AU+000Alogbook: main fast-forwarded 4458ba76 to b4ca0b89. Both agent worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ inspected clean and removed with plain git worktree remove, no force needed or used, then pruned. Four local branches deleted after re-confirming each as an ancestor of origin/main: fix/close-releases-pointer, docs/scope-is-stored-not-derived, and the two worktree-agent scaffolding branches. preserve/cross-author-repro left untouched, local and remote, as deliberately retained and genuinely unmerged.U+000AU+000A.windful-ocean: working tree confirmed clean, checkout moved from docs/pointer-carries-three-fields to main, main fast-forwarded ecf08cc7 to ad1cd6dd. The two branches this session created deleted locally. Scope fence held: local branch count went from 98 to 96, and the worktree listing is identical in membership to before, including both agent worktrees and all six ledger worktrees under ~/.claude/plugins/data/.U+000AU+000AAll four remote deletions returned exit 1 because the branches were already gone from origin. GitHub's delete-branch-on-merge had removed them when the PRs landed. Confirmed with ls-remote rather than assumed, and the desired end state already held in every case; fetch --prune then cleared the stale tracking refs.U+000AU+000ACriterion c1 01M1TSFK1TVWD6M0AKS45TK6R3 marked done, verified: node --test test/spawn/close.test.ts exit 0 with four passing, red on parent at exit 1 with three failing, inert when the release line is deleted, and now merged to main.U+000AU+000ABoth opening risks retired: 01M1TSFVMHT6HZH4KPR7BA8PPE, the stale terminal-named pointer reported as a crash, and 01M1TSFVMHVCHR6QCSNS9QMBQK, the empty scope label contradicting documented behaviour. The first is fixed in code; the second was resolved as a documentation defect rather than a code one.U+000AU+000AThe documentation criterion 01M1TWKPTR0HE3VTVVV5W7TS5D is NOT yet marked done. Its check names a grep over both copies of the rule plus a green suite, and nobody has run it against either merged tree. Verifier dispatched to run it rather than reasoning from the leads' pre-merge reports.U+000AU+000Ac3 01M1TSFK1TV1E9X8WQG2N2E3TD remains open and cannot be satisfied from this session as it stands. It requires a full hand-off pass over the LIVE server, and the running plugin is the installed 6.0.0 copy, which predates the close_thread fix. Satisfying it needs the plugin reinstalled from merged main and Claude Code restarted first.
